profile.headline: Full Stack Engineer II at Capital One | Backend & Cloud Engineering | Python • Java • Docker • AWS • CI/CD • AI
profile.summary: Full Stack Engineer II at Capital One with experience across backend and cloud engineering. I build and maintain scalable systems using Java, Docker, and AWS, contributing to the development of secure and reliable backend services that support enterprise-scale financial applications.Previously part of Capital One’s PE Virtual Core Engineering team, I designed automation and compliance workflows leveraging Python and AWS Lambda, improving cloud visibility and operational efficiency.

positions.title: Manager I, Operations
positions.description:
Supervised a team of 30+ associates, overseeing pick operations with PIT machines to handle items over 50 lbs.

Developed and implemented new safety procedures for site, significantly reducing safety-related injuries.

Collaborated with departments including PXT, Loss Prevention, Safety, Learning, and Procurement to streamline operations.

Strategically planned nightly shifts to consistently meet customer demand.

Enforced compliance with all building rules and regulations to maintain safety and productivity.

Created an automated Excel tracker for training transcripts, ensuring timely training and retraining of associates.
positions.insights: Operations Management, Supply Chain Management and +1 skill

positions.title: Resident Director
positions.description:
Trained undergraduate Residential Life staff on emergency protocols, conflict resolution, and customer service

Conducted regular evaluations of Residential Life staff, including setting goals and providing feedback for improvement

Developed and implemented several educational and social programs for residents, tracking attendance and impact on students satisfaction

Worked with Student Affairs and Campus Life offices to coordinate programming and support for residents

Monitored and tracked residential hall maintenance and repair requests, ensuring timely resolution and tracking cost and budget impacts

Collaborated with the Student Conduct office to address disciplinary issues within the residential halls and tracked resolution outcomes

Analyzed and reported on residential hall data, including occupancy rates, student satisfaction surveys, and retention rates

Participated in the selection and training process for new Residential Life staff members

Developed and maintained relationships with on-campus resources and organizations to enhance the residential experience for students.
positions.insights: Student Housing, Higher Education and +1 skill

positions.title: Technical Sourcing Recruiter
positions.description:
Developed mid to senior level Software Development Engineering prospects into candidates, engaged, sustained relationships, screened, and prepared for interview in a high-volume recruiting environment

Piloted "Best Fit" program, aimed to allow eligible candidates apply only once to be considered for hundreds of available SWE roles - allowing candidates to preference location, team, tech stack, and even manager selection

Recruited passive candidates by building strategic searches and Boolean strings in programs like LinkedIn Recruiter, HireEZ, Beamery, GitHub, and other sources

Implemented diverse sourcing strategies to identify underrepresented populations like BLNA, LGBTQ+, Veterans, and non-traditional candidates

Managed applicant tracking system, reviewed applications, and initiated contact for interviews

Implemented sourcing strategies to focus on getting eligible candidates into Amazon's pipeline to identify fit

Worked within a team spread across the nation to develop new sourcing techniques and strategies

Sourced on average over 400 eligible candidates per week, building a pipeline of over 1400 candidates

positions.title: Sr. Human Resources Generalist
positions.description:
2022 Operations Intern Program Champion - SDF9

T1-T3 recruiter within SDF9, consisted of reviewing resumes, scheduling interviews, and extending offer letters for our SDF9 Mavericks'

Used HRIS software on a daily basis: PeopleSoft, ICIMS, Kronos, Salesforce, and others

Resolved issues regarding missed time, punch corrections, conducted investigations, answered benefits/policy questions, and sent out daily roster reports to assist Operations with achieving their daily metrics.

Piloted the Day 0 Orientation Program for SDF9, an experimental onboarding project within the ReLo Node that only 25 sites across the network participated in

Helped increase week to week Lunar completion within the building

Worked on improving Self Service within SDF9

Part of NAFC PXT Role Alignment Conversion Cycle for HR Partner

Manually converted over 500 seasonal associates to Blue Badge associates using Salesforce, Quicksight, and Excel, helping with retention and also helping associates receive benefits

Created signage and handouts highlighting the network change for FLEXPT & FLEXRT policies for the entire building

Assisted LUK7 by providing temporary coverage via STA while their PXT department was short staffed
